intent.user_request: 用这张清洁刷商品图做一条前后效果明显的15秒竖屏短视频，产品始终要看得清楚。
intent.resolved_request: Produce a 15-second vertical-format short video using the supplied cleaning brush product image as the authoritative product appearance, featuring an obvious before/after effect, with the product kept clearly visible throughout.
assumptions: IR completion: the obvious before/after effect is interpreted as the brushed surface visibly changing from soiled/grime-covered to clean, while the brush product appearance itself stays unchanged.
IR completion: the cleaned surface is a neutral light-colored hard surface (countertop-like); the exact surface type was not specified.
IR completion: the surface is introduced as subject_2 to carry the before/after state transition; it has no source asset and is defined conservatively for this effect.
IR completion: the 15-second runtime is split as 0-4s before state, 4-11s single continuous cleaning sweep, 11-15s completion and final presentation.
IR completion: no hands, people, text overlays, or UI elements appear in the frame, keeping the product clearly visible per d_5.
IR completion: generated audio is a short upbeat music bed with brushing/motor sound effects synced to the sweep; no voiceover is generated because none was requested.
IR completion: image_product is treated as the authoritative product appearance source only; its background, lighting, and camera perspective are not inherited.
uncertainties: The exact grime pattern, surface material, and soiling density of the before state are unspecified; conservative neutral defaults were assumed and recorded in assumptions.

subjects.name: electric cleaning brush
subjects.description: A handheld electric cleaning brush with a cylindrical ivory-white matte body, a light blue circular brush head on a slightly slanted neck, a coral orange oval power button on the mid-body, and a dark gray thin base ring.
subjects.retention_description: The brush's geometry, colors, component layout, and matte finish remain identical to the product image in every shot; only the surrounding surface state changes.

subjects.name: cleaning surface
subjects.description: A neutral light-colored hard surface that visibly transitions from soiled with grime to fully clean across the video.
subjects.retention_description: No source asset; the surface is an IR-defined environment created conservatively to carry the before/after cleaning transition.

reference_relationships.definition: the authoritative cleaning brush product appearance reference controlling the brush's geometry, colors, and component layout in the generated before/after video
reference_relationships.retention_description: The product geometry and colors are transferred fully and kept constant across all generated shots; the cleaned-surface scene, lighting, camera, and audio are newly generated.

creative_focus.primary_target: the electric cleaning brush performing an obvious surface-cleaning before/after transition
creative_focus.objective: A 15-second vertical video in which the cleaning brush stays clearly visible and convincingly demonstrates an unmistakable before/after cleaning transition, ending with the surface fully clean while the product's appearance remains identical to the product image.
presentation_requirements: The brush must remain in sharp focus and fully inside the 9:16 frame in every shot, with head, body, button, and base ring legible and unobstructed by grime, foam, hands, or overlays.
The before/after change is expressed on the brushed surface only; the brush's geometry, colors, and component layout never change.
At least one shot shows a single continuous brushing motion sweeping across the grime with an immediately visible clean trail.
The final shot holds the upright, unchanged brush beside a fully clean surface so the after state is unambiguous.
No text overlays, logos, brand claims, or packaging from the source image are introduced.

preserve: cleaning brush geometry and colors exactly as in image_product: cylindrical ivory-white matte body, light blue circular brush head, coral orange oval mid-body button, dark gray thin base ring, slightly slanted neck
allow_change: the brushed surface state transitions from soiled to fully clean
newly generated vertical framing, camera moves, lighting, and scene environment
brush pose and motion during the cleaning demonstration, while geometry and colors stay fixed
newly generated audio: upbeat music bed and brushing/motor sound effects
prohibit: changing the brush's geometry, colors, component layout, or finish
obscuring the product with grime, foam, hands, props, or overlays at any point
cropping the product out of frame or letting it go out of focus
adding brand names, logos, text overlays, dialogue, or claims not present in the source
inheriting the source image's background, lighting, or camera perspective

timeline.primary_change: The before state is established: a visibly soiled surface appears beneath the motionless brush.
timeline.event: The cleaning brush, appearing exactly as in the product image, hovers centered in the vertical frame with its light blue circular head slanted toward a grime-covered patch on the surface below; stains and smudges are clearly visible on the surface.
timeline.action: The brush is held steady with no movement; no hands appear in frame.
timeline.camera: Static Shot; the frame never moves, with no pan, push-in, zoom, or reframing.
timeline.lighting: Bright, soft, even lighting that makes the surface grime clearly legible while keeping the brush colors accurate to the reference image.
timeline.observable_end_state: A soiled surface with visible grime occupies the lower half of the frame; the brush is centered above it, fully visible and in sharp focus.

state_changes.from: not in contact; hovering above the soiled surface with head slanted downward
state_changes.to: still not in contact; positioned directly over the most soiled area
soiled with clearly visible grime (before state)

timeline.primary_change: One continuous left-to-right sweep visibly removes the grime and leaves a clean trail.
timeline.event: The brush lowers its circular head onto the grimy patch and sweeps steadily from left to right; grime lifts and disappears beneath the moving head, leaving a visibly clean trail behind it, with a small grime patch remaining at the right edge when the sweep stops.
timeline.action: The brush is guided in a steady horizontal sweep with the head flat against the surface; hands stay out of frame.
timeline.camera: Slow push-in from a medium vertical framing toward a close-up of the clean trail over the full 7 seconds, at constant speed, tightening the framing by roughly 25%.
timeline.lighting: Bright, even lighting that maximizes the contrast between the clean trail and the remaining grime.
timeline.observable_end_state: Most of the visible surface is clean; a small grime patch remains at the far right edge; the brush head is lifted slightly off the surface at the end of the sweep.

state_changes.from: hovering above the soiled patch, no contact
state_changes.to: lifted slightly off the surface after completing the left-to-right sweep
mostly clean with a residual grime patch at the right edge

timeline.primary_change: The cleaning transition completes: the residual grime is removed and the fully clean after state is presented with the upright brush.
timeline.event: The brush returns over the residual patch and makes a short second pass that clears the remaining grime, then rises to an upright presentation pose beside the now completely clean surface; the final frame holds the clean surface with the brush fully visible.
timeline.action: One short sweep clears the residual patch, then the brush tilts upright with the head up and the body vertical.
timeline.camera: Static Shot; the frame never moves, with no pan, push-in, zoom, or reframing.
timeline.lighting: Bright, clean, even lighting; the surface reads as fully clean and the brush colors match the reference image exactly.
timeline.transition: None; the final frame holds to the end of the video.
timeline.observable_end_state: The entire visible surface is clean with no grime; the brush stands upright and fully visible in sharp focus, with its ivory-white body, light blue circular head, coral orange button, and dark gray base ring unchanged.

state_changes.from: head lifted slightly off the surface at the right edge over the residual patch
state_changes.to: upright presentation pose, head up, fully visible

state_changes.from: mostly clean with residual grime at the right edge

audio_plan.voice: None; no voiceover, narration, or dialogue is generated.
audio_plan.music: Light, upbeat short-form product-video music bed, low to medium energy, mixed beneath the sound effects so the product visuals stay dominant.
audio_plan.sound_effects: Soft mechanical hum of the brush motor during the sweep, a light brushing/swiping texture while the head moves across the surface, and a subtle whoosh at the start of each sweep.
audio_plan.ambient_sound: None; no room ambience beyond the music bed.
sync_rules: Music starts at 0:00 and resolves softly at 15:00 when the clean surface and upright brush are shown.
Motor hum and brushing texture start at 4s with the first sweep and fade out at 11s when the sweep ends.
A short whoosh accent marks the start of each sweep at 4s and 11s.

generation_description.cinematography: Vertical 9:16 framing throughout; shot 01 static medium framing of the brush above the soiled surface, shot 02 a slow push-in toward the clean trail, shot 03 a static framing of the upright brush and fully clean surface; no pans, zooms, or reframing in static shots.
generation_description.lighting: Bright, even, soft lighting across all shots so grime contrast stays legible and the brush colors remain accurate to the reference image; no hard shadows fall on the product.
generation_description.materials: The brush renders with a matte ivory-white cylindrical body, light blue circular bristle head, coral orange oval button, and dark gray thin base ring; the surface reads as a smooth hard material that visibly changes from stained to clean.
generation_description.performance: The brush performs one long left-to-right sweep (4-11s), then a short second pass over the residual patch (11-12s), then rises to an upright presentation pose; motion is steady, continuous, and hand-free, and the product never leaves focus.
generation_description.continuity: Brush geometry, colors, and component layout are identical in every shot and match image_product; the surface progresses from soiled to mostly clean to fully clean; brush-head contact and pose states are tracked across shots; the product stays fully visible and in sharp focus for the entire 15 seconds.
